science.hamiltonian: H = sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j - B sum_i X_i,  J_ij ~ N(0, 1/N) for i<j, symmetrized
science.field: per-instance finite-N ground-state von Neumann entropy peak on A=lowest floor(N/2) spins; not thermodynamic critical; not Gamma=1
science.entropy_cut: A=lowest floor(N/2) logical spins; natural-log von Neumann; not cavity
science.parity: positive even branch; B=0 not on primary grid; invalid peaks flagged not replaced

spsa.recipe: R9 depth_core IID: 2 starts + 16 calibration + 4T + 2*floor(T/5) monitors + padding + 6 readouts = Q
spsa.selection: lowest energy among all charged queries; F after the fact

bfgs.widths: even start_index width 0.6 broad, odd 0.16 narrow
bfgs.selection: lowest-energy start among 16; also report max F if different start

scheduler.cap_from: cgroup cpu.max quota or cpuset.effective/affinity, not host os.cpu_count
scheduler.midjob_SIGSTOP: not used in this initial scheduler; do not claim instant preemption

workloads.note: BFGS nfev unknown until after pilot; no wall-time claim in this file

seeds.formula_pilot: SEED_BASE + N*1000 + 800 + index, index=0..0 (one disjoint seed per N)
